a_linear.board_basis: the whole board: every fold priced

projection_to_the_ranking_months.basis: the ranking file under the serving rule, per airport

conservative.why: the fold-side board is the base's OOF error on 2025 and the leaderboard board is its error on the 2026 ranking file; the paired gain's first term is linear in the base's own residual, so a projection that carries the fold's per-moved-row gain unchanged assumes the base errs as much on the ranking rows as on the fold rows, which it does not

projection_to_the_ranking_months.note: a projection, not a measured board move: it assumes the per-moved-row gain measured on a 2025 fold holds on the 2026 rows the matcher reaches at the same airport, and it is stated separately from every fold-side number, which stays on the contract.  The board share of the two ranking months is not used here: the projection is a mean over the whole ranking file, which is what the RMSE of the file is.

The noac hold is this lane's and any composition of the two candidates has to keep it.

predeclared.amplitude: one weight per airport, fitted on the fitting months only, clipped to [0, 1]. An airport with fewer than MIN_AIRPORT_ROWS fitting rows gets weight 0 and is left at v11.

arms.a_linear: p11 + w_airport * (obs_taxi - offset_airport - p11) on matched rows
arms.b_lgb: p11 + s_airport * lgb(feature block -> r11) on matched rows
arms.c_lgb_shipped: arm b with the 76 non-vocabulary numeric columns of the shipped feature block beside the observation

predeclared.base: v11 = v10 + 0.217*(stack-5 - v10), fold-side, exp-039 v10.load() and exp-036 bases.load()
predeclared.cross_fit: day blocks inside the fitting months: 5 contiguous blocks per month, a row's prediction always comes from a model that did not see its block
predeclared.gate: all-row paired gain over v11 with every fold interval clear of zero
predeclared.noac: d = 0 on every noac row, by construction and checked
predeclared.rotation: score fold f, fit on the OTHER two fold months. Only 2025-01, 2025-07 and 2025-12 carry an out-of-fold v11 residual, so 'the 2025 months other than the scored fold' is those two.

rotation.deviation_from_the_literal_wording: the assignment says 'fit on the 2025 months other than the scored fold', which reads as nine or eleven months. Only 2025-01, 2025-07 and 2025-12 carry an OUT-OF-FOLD base prediction: v12 is the same composition as v11 with the climbed member in the head's place, and its head, v7 and stack-5 vectors exist for the three fold panels only, so `rbase = y - pbase` -- the quantity every weight in every arm is fitted against -- does not exist on the other nine months. Fitting on them is not a choice this stage declined; it is a quantity the base does not have. The airport OFFSET of arm (a) needs no residual and could be fitted on any labelled month, and is deliberately fitted on the same two so that ONE rotation describes the whole arm rather than two. Sol round 1, blocking 5, is right that this is a deviation; it is recorded, not repaired, and the repair would be a fold-side base on all twelve months, which is exp-038's artifact and not this stage's.
rotation.fitted_on: the other two of those three
rotation.prefix_map_note: the airline prefix map that reconstructs a missing broadcast callsign is learned on the nine 2025 months that are NOT fold months, so it is out of fold for every fold at once (Sol round 1, blocking 6).
